description: Active Enyo NNUE improvement-run config. Use this as the reviewed candidate recipe.
goal: Test whether the Reckless-like Bullet architecture is practical at 512 hidden after 768 hidden loaded correctly but was too slow in Enyo.

success_condition: Bullet text conversion and BulletFormat validation pass
Enyo can load the selected 512-hidden quantised.bin checkpoint
Bullet parity and direct eval benchmark improve materially versus 768-hidden (~1.8M eval/s)
next_after_success: compare 512-hidden speed against the previous 768-hidden checkpoint
only consider SPRT if speed is acceptable and validation signal is exceptional
